The court granted the wife ownership of the property, while also placing the mortgage debt on her. This ruling allowed her to maintain the home without needing to refinance, which left the husband still tied to the mortgage.

The collision involved an AVE train and an Iryo train on the Madrid-Seville route, disrupting rail services connecting Madrid with Ciudad Real and Andalusia.

description: Spain's rail infrastructure operator ADIF confirmed the accident and announced the suspension of services on the affected routes. According to Spanish state broadcaster TVE, the collision involved two high-speed trains travelling in the same direction. One train reportedly struck the rear of the other, causing two carriages to come off the tracks.

Witnesses reported that the assailant yelled Islamist phrases during the attack. Serbian officials have classified the event as a terrorist act, prompting an elevation of the national terror alert.

title: 'Drishyam 3 The Conclusion' BO Day 27: Movie chases Rs 375 crore India net mark

description: Rajinikanth's latest blockbuster 'Jailer 2' has achieved a remarkable Rs 490 crore in box office earnings within just two weeks. Featuring stellar performances by Mohanlal and Vidya Balan, the film had a phenomenal opening day with Rs 59.70 crore. Despite a slight dip on weekdays, its popularity endures across multiple languages, and anticipation for its third week's performance remains high.

description: As Cyclone Arnab approaches India's eastern coast, Karwa Chauth on 29 October presents unique challenges for those observing the fast. The potential obscuring of the Moon by storm clouds may disrupt traditional practices. However, devotees can still honor the day by worshipping lunar symbols, such as a silver coin or Lord Shiva, while families should check local moonrise times for adherence to customs.

author: MAHIMA SHARMA
description: During a campaign rally, Donald Trump made pointed accusations against Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed, alleging connections to Sharia law and the Muslim Brotherhood. Trump raised issues about El-Sayed's fitness for Congress, advocating for increased scrutiny if he wins. El-Sayed has refuted Trump's claims of posing a national security threat.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Researchers at University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign and Technical University of Denmark developed a thermal invisibility cloak. This cloak effectively hides complex objects from infrared cameras while managing extreme temperatures. It successfully redirected heat away from intricate shapes during testing, demonstrating its potential applications in electronics and security. Future work will focus on concealing heat-generating objects to enhance technological capabilities.
title: Scientists develop 3D cloak that hides complex objects from infrared cameras

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: During her journey to South Africa, Alicia Keys encountered the profound effects of HIV/AIDS on families and children, which ignited her passion to co-found Keep a Child Alive in 2003. The organization has successfully raised over $86 million, benefiting millions globally by ensuring access to medical care while advocating for health, education, and human rights. Collaborations, such as with TodayTix Group, significantly amplify their mission.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: An exquisite gold coin from the 14th century, known as a leopard, has recently fetched a staggering £70,000 at auction. Issued during the reign of King Edward III, this coin was only in circulation for seven months before its discontinuation. Although its run was brief, the leopard coins are now regarded as rare treasures, reflecting Edward III's ambitious yet unsuccessful endeavor to enhance England's monetary system.
title: Edward III gold coin, in circulation just 7 months, sells for £70,000

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Neeraj Yadav, a prominent para-athlete, was found dead at his residence and is believed to have died by suicide. He won three gold medals at the Asian Para Games, showcasing his talent in athletics. Yadav faced a doping case earlier in 2023 that impacted his career significantly. Despite his challenges, he represented India with great pride and determination. His untimely death has left a significant void in the para-sports community.
title: Neeraj Yadav: Polio, 3 Asian Para Games golds, doping ban and a life cut short

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A federal judge has deemed Bill Essayli's appointment as U.S. attorney to be unlawful. While this ruling comes with a temporary stay, it leaves him in his position for now. This case is crucial, as it raises questions about the legitimacy of federal prosecutor appointments. The Justice Department might decide to appeal, possibly bringing the matter before the Supreme Court for a final verdict.

title: 'Failed to make presence felt': BJP's 'ballot paper' jibe at Rahul after MLC poll rout

description: In 2026, Dalal Street faces a challenging landscape as the Nifty50 sinks by 13%, prompting investors to weigh the merits of buying stocks at discounted rates. The path to market recovery hinges on several factors: the resurgence of earnings, influx of foreign investments, and fluctuations in crude oil prices. description: BlackBerry is redefining its business model, moving away from the consumer mobile phone sector towards innovative artificial intelligence-driven robotic technologies. Their QNX operating system is impressively gaining traction across sectors such as robotics and medical devices. With increasing demand and collaborations with Nvidia, BlackBerry is experiencing considerable revenue growth. description: Tal Alexander and his twin brothers, Oren and Alon Alexander, have been sentenced to 30 years in prison following their convictions for drugging and sexually assaulting multiple women. The victims articulated their emotional trauma during the trial, prompting prosecutors to call for maximum penalties. The defense, however, pleaded for leniency, referencing family commitments. Despite their claims of innocence, the brothers’ severe actions led to significant consequences.

After reporting the issue to metro security, he fled the scene, taking his phone back. The Bengaluru City Police have registered an FIR and are conducting an investigation into the matter.

title: How Serbia’s 250-member parliament will look after the student-led movement’s win

description: At Tweak Summit 2026, Shruti Haasan offered thought-provoking insights on the art of parenting. She stressed the critical role of parents in fostering autonomy, which is vital for children's development. Citing research, she noted that this nurturing approach can significantly enhance academic and psychological well-being. Parents are encouraged to provide choices suitable for their children's age, coupled with necessary boundaries, promoting independence and self-expression.
title: Shruti Haasan calls Kamal her biggest ally; why independent children matter

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: In innovative research, scientists observed dwarf reed snakes in Southeast Asia adeptly using rapid cartwheeling to escape threats. Achieving speeds of 5.6 to 12.1 feet per second, this striking movement technique aids their survival against predators in the wild. These findings shed light on the diverse locomotion strategies of small reptiles, prompting further investigations into the mechanics and energy costs of their remarkable escape tactics.
title: Tiny snakes in Malaysia cartwheel at up to 12 feet per second to escape danger

author: TEJASHREE BHOPATKAR SAWANT
description: Director Santosh Davakhar is preparing for the release of his film 'Gondhal' on November 13. This psychological thriller represents Maharashtra's cultural heritage and is India's official entry for the Academy Awards. The film will be released in seven languages to reach a wider audience while retaining cultural authenticity. Davakhar emphasizes the importance of strong storytelling and audience support for the growth of Marathi cinema.
title: ''Ramayana' would give our film more room': ‘Gondhal’ director Santosh Davakhar

author: SANDEEP MOUDGAL
description: In the recent Karnataka Legislative Council elections, the BJP-led National Democratic Alliance achieved a significant victory. Candidates from the NDA won all four contested seats, impacting the ruling Congress party. The results included wins in both teachers' constituencies, showcasing strong performance. Counting was ongoing late into the night as results were finalized. This outcome poses a considerable challenge for Chief Minister D K Shivakumar and his administration.

The bowlers effectively restricted New Zealand's score, underscoring the team's remarkable unity and selfless contribution towards this victory.

Heavy rainfall exceeding 200 mm was recorded in several districts, with trees and electric poles uprooted. Flight operations were disrupted as services were cancelled or suspended across airports in coastal Andhra Pradesh. Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu directed officials to restore normalcy and provide aid for the affected areas.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: A Bengaluru resident made a smart move by purchasing a 2015 Maruti Suzuki Celerio for Rs 3 lakh, aiming to ease his daily commute. By opting for an older model, he seeks to protect his newer sedan from the urban grind. After an auto-rickshaw incident lightly scratched his Celerio, his calm response drew nods of agreement from other motorists, emphasizing the benefits of such vehicles in bustling city settings.
title: Bengaluru man buys Rs 3 lakh used car to save new sedan from dents, scratches

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: A team of researchers has made a groundbreaking achievement by replicating the color-shifting glass of the ancient Roman Lycurgus Cup. Created 1,600 years ago, this unique glass displays stunning optical effects thanks to its tiny gold and silver nanoparticles. Their rigorous experimentation with both ancient and modern techniques opens doors for scientific advancements, extending beyond mere artistic creation. A modern sculpture inspired by this historic artifact will soon be unveiled.
title: Scientists recreate 1,600-year-old Roman cup's colour-changing glass

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Justin Jefferson’s charity bowling event, aptly named 'Strike Out Cancer', successfully raised over $45,000 for cancer research. This heartwarming gathering united patients, survivors, and caregivers, all supporting the American Cancer Society. Among the attendees was seven-year-old Claire Van Epps, who, battling cancer, received Super Bowl LXI tickets. Jefferson’s initiative sheds light on cancer patients and their families, while his foundation continues its impactful community contributions.
title: Justin Jefferson raises $45k for cancer, gifts 7-year-old Super Bowl tickets

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Jio Platforms celebrated a remarkable stock market entry, debuting at Rs 1,358 per share. The IPO attracted an impressive 22.19 times oversubscription, with bids surpassing Rs 7.4 lakh crore. Following this, the firm's market capitalisation soared to around Rs 12.5 lakh crore, securing its position as India's second most valuable company.
title: Jio makes strong debut at 21% premium to become India's second-most valuable firm

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Kylian Mbappé faced intense criticism in China after labeling Mao Zedong a dictator during a video chat. This sparked outrage, prompting sponsors like Dongpeng and Mengniu to terminate their deals with him. Chinese media called for apologies from both the player and Real Madrid, leading to a halt in La Liga broadcasts featuring Mbappé. The incident underscores the fragility of commercial relationships in China in light of public statements.
title: How Mbappé's 'dictator' remark on Mao led to China suspending La Liga broadcasts

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: In an important ruling, a district consumer commission in Karnataka found that South Western Railway did not provide sufficient services to its passengers. A traveler and his family endured discomfort stemming from a lack of water in the washrooms and subsequently exited the train to lodge a complaint that went unresolved. Ultimately, the commission favored the complainant, requiring the railway to issue a refund and additional compensation.
title: No water in washrooms, family forced to get off train; Railways to pay Rs 16k

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: On October 26, Thomas van Tonder achieved a remarkable feat by completing a crossing under Bloukrans Bridge, navigating through 600 monkey bars in a challenging 280-meter course. This grueling challenge tested his grip strength, endurance, and mental fortitude as he prepared for two rigorous years. He triumphantly finished in 47 minutes and 37 seconds, showcasing his exceptional capabilities in the realm of extreme obstacle racing.
title: South African athlete crosses 600 monkey bars 216m above river in 47 minutes

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Jio Platforms Limited made a notable debut on the stock market, listing at a premium of 21.36%. The public issue was highly successful, being subscribed 22.19 times and valued at over Rs 10 lakh crore. Isha, Akash, and Anant Ambani commemorated their father's legacy while outlining future ambitions for the company. Akash Ambani expressed a commitment to democratizing technology over the next decade.
title: Mukesh Ambani gets teary-eyed as children talk about Reliance's journey at Jio listing

author: ARVIND CHAUHAN
description: The BJP secured four out of eleven seats in the recent Uttar Pradesh Legislative Council elections. Samajwadi Party candidate Lal Bihari Yadav won the Varanasi Teachers' constituency while BJP retained Meerut seats. Tensions arose at counting centers, with allegations of assault and electoral malpractice reported. Akash Agarwal of the SP claimed physical aggression from BJP supporters during the tensions.
title: Akhilesh's Samajwadi Party scores a win in PM Modi’s Varanasi in UP MLC polls

author: SHREEDHAR RATHI
description: The Kerala government took action against police officials after lapses in investigating a fatal accident in Cheranallur. Kochi City Police Commissioner Kaliraj Mahesh Kumar has been transferred, along with the suspension of four personnel. Initial charges related to negligence were altered to culpable homicide as evidence of overspeeding emerged. Victim Jayabalakrishnan's family is demanding further actions against the teenager's father, who is a judge.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: 'Maxxing' has emerged as a popular term reflecting the contemporary quest for ongoing self-improvement in the digital realm. This word symbolizes a fusion of ambition with the culture of online life, transforming routine activities into opportunities for enhancement. It underscores the challenging balance between enriching our lives and succumbing to relentless optimization. Acknowledged by Dictionary.com as the Word of the Year for 2026, 'maxxing' mirrors current societal aspirations.

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: India's mobile phone manufacturing sector has generated Rs 25,000 crore in direct tax collections and Rs 3,000 crore in GST. Union minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced new schemes to further enhance production and strengthen global supply chains. The Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme will operate from FY 2026-27 to FY 2030-31, with Rs 62,500 crore allocated. It aims to increase domestic sourcing and support Indian mobile brands through incentives.

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Mitchell Starc made headlines with his stellar 20th five-wicket haul in Test cricket, claiming 6/72 against South Africa. His fiery spell ignited a collapse in the opponent's batting lineup, shifting the momentum dramatically. From a strong position at 203/1, South Africa crumbled to 329 all out, intensifying the series, which now stands at 1-1, underscoring the match's importance.
title: Mitchell Starc equals Dale Steyn, leaves several legends behind in elite list

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: The Jharkhand high court has acquitted a man previously sentenced for murder, citing severe flaws in his trial proceedings. Notably, the court highlighted that the accused was not adequately interrogated about crucial evidence, and his statement was recorded in English without a suitable translation. Additionally, eyewitness accounts were inconsistent, and physical evidence linking him to the crime was lacking.
title: Murder conviction set aside as Jharkhand HC flags trial questioning in English

author: NIKHIL SHARMA
description: A woman in Delhi experienced a frightening encounter with an Uber driver demanding a higher fare. After refusing to pay the inflated amount, the driver allegedly restrained her and withheld her luggage. The situation escalated as the driver followed her home, threatening her life. Despite her efforts to report the incident, she was unable to access Uber's safety support feature.
title: ‘Locked car, abuse’: How an Uber ride turned into an ordeal for Gurgaon techie

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: In a generous move, Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan have pledged $50 million to Sacramento State University. The contribution will assist in the conversion of three state office buildings into an innovative campus, enhancing student housing and creating state-of-the-art STEM and AI facilities. This initiative reflects their evolving priorities towards backing biomedical AI research, particularly in light of discussions surrounding a possible wealth tax on California's billionaires.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Japan is witnessing a dramatic transformation in its marine ecosystems as rising ocean temperatures prompt fish species to migrate northward. An extensive research effort involving the analysis of water samples has revealed profound implications for local fisheries, economies, and the overall health of marine life. With the introduction of new species, traditional fishing methods may need to evolve, underscoring the crucial role of environmental DNA in monitoring these biodiversity changes.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: At 82, Sukhma from Sundana village has become a beacon of inspiration for many. With her grandson's encouragement, she embraced the thrill of motorcycle riding and mastered it, proving that age is merely a number. Not stopping there, Sukhma ventured into driving tractors too. Through her shared experiences on social media, she encourages others to pursue new passions, showing that the pursuit of knowledge and adventure knows no age limits.
title: Meet 82-year-old Haryana dadi who learnt to ride a bike at 74, drives tractors

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: An Indiana couple successfully secured an $82,020 judgment against a contractor for breach of contract and fraudulent misrepresentations. Tasked with property repairs, the contractor failed to deliver promised materials and left payments for roofing supplies unaccounted for, ultimately leading to a lawsuit. The court held him personally liable, underscoring the importance of accountability in construction agreements and the serious consequences of dishonest practices.

description: Indian para-athletics was left in shock after three-time Asian Para Games gold medallist Neeraj Yadav allegedly died by suicide at a flat on Tuesday night. The 42-year-old, who competed in the F55 category, suspected to have consumed poison. A postmortem examination was underway at Delhi’s GTB Hospital on Wednesday at the time of filing the report.
title: Three-time Asian Para Games gold medallist Neeraj Yadav dies by suicide

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Triple H and Stephanie McMahon have spent decades shaping WWE, but their family life extends beyond the wrestling ring and corporate boardroom, and their three daughters, Aurora Rose, Murphy Claire and Vaughn Evelyn Levesque, have developed interests ranging from softball and football to animal rescue, music and dance. author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Microsoft is offering buyouts to around 60,000 employees, over a quarter of its workforce, in India, the US, the UK and Canada. HR head Amy Coleman announced the Voluntary Exit Offer in a memo to staff. The package matches standard severance, which can run up to 39 weeks of pay. Xbox, Copilot and Windows teams are eligible, sales is excluded, and the deadline is December.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Nu’utele Island in Samoa is witnessing a remarkable revival as invasive rats and pigs have been eradicated. This positive shift has encouraged the resurgence of native bird species and provided safe nesting grounds for sea turtles. Furthermore, local communities are experiencing enhanced food production linked to the restoration of native plants. Such revitalization underscores the critical need for ongoing conservation efforts to safeguard biodiversity and combat climate change effects.
title: After rats and pigs removed, sea turtles return to Pacific island after decades

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: An elaborate fraud scheme has bilked elderly Americans out of approximately $65 million. The operation, which was traced back to India-based call centers and fake personas, preyed on victims to send money through wire transfers and gift cards. YouTube creators played a crucial role in this investigation by unmasking the scammers and documenting their exploits. Consequently, multiple arrests have been made, with legal actions against the offenders continuing.

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a significant ruling, the D.C. Court of Appeals has reinstated a civil protection order filed by grandmother Fonda Allen against her grandchildren's biological mother, Tamieka Whitehead. Allen, who holds legal custody, accused Whitehead of verbal abuse and harassment. This decision clarifies familial definitions under the Intrafamily Offenses Act, allowing the case to proceed after a prior dismissal based on jurisdiction.

author: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA
description: Partial results put Netanyahu’s bloc ahead with 57 seats against 47 for the opposition, while exit polls suggest neither side has a clear path to a parliamentary majority. Arab-led parties could prove crucial in coalition negotiations.

title: BJP-Akali alliance: Talks on to hammer out seat-sharing arrangement in Punjab

description: Abhishek Sharma celebrated his century against New Zealand while responding to Yuvraj Singh’s playful reminder. Yuvraj highlighted his record of a 12-ball fifty during the exchange. Nepal's Dipendra Singh Airee set a new record in 2023 with a nine-ball fifty. Abhishek emphasized team goals over personal milestones in his innings. India secured a convincing victory with Abhishek’s performance, leading the series 3-0.
title: 'You can't just go and score': Abhishek Sharma responds to Yuvraj Singh's 12-ball fifty jibe

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: West Indies coach Daren Sammy praised his team's performance in the recent T20I series against India. The West Indies managed a commendable 2-2 draw against the formidable Indian team on their home ground. Sammy emphasized the challenges posed by India's batting power and smaller boundaries during their matches. He acknowledged the progress made by his team despite facing tough opposition.

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: The red carpet premiere of 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' was held in Los Angeles recently. Leading stars Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash attended the event dressed in traditional attire. Director Nitesh Tiwari and producer Namit Malhotra also participated in the red-carpet event with the cast. The film has generated significant anticipation and will officially release in India on November 5, 2026.

title: Netanyahu seeks 'right-wing, national, strong govt' in tight Israel election race

description: BP Singh, the revered producer of iconic shows like CID and Aahat, has tragically passed away due to a heart attack. His longtime friend and co-star Shivaji Satam expressed profound grief over the loss of a guiding figure, emphasizing Singh's unwavering commitment to his craft despite his health issues. Many within the television community are reflecting on Singh's invaluable impact on storytelling and performance in Indian media.

description: Although the proposed billionaire wealth tax looms over California, Palmer Luckey, the founder of Anduril Industries, remains steadfast in the state. He stands against the tax, arguing that it could drive away residents and negatively impact California's economy. Luckey expresses particular concern over the implications of taxing super-voting shares, which he believes unfairly target tech executives.

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Bradley Cooper's family residence in Pennsylvania, originally acquired for $38,000 in 1970, now commands an impressive value of nearly $700,000. This home carries deep sentimental value for Cooper as he reflects on his upbringing. Additionally, he owns a remarkable estate in New Hope, purchased for $6.5 million, showcasing a blend of historic charm and modern luxury amidst 33 acres of stunning land, illustrating his strong ties to Pennsylvania.

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Amazon's engineering executives have revised the guidelines for Software Development Engineers, emphasizing the necessity of achieving tangible results in the real world. They urge engineers to seamlessly integrate AI into their everyday workflows to remain competitive. The communication stresses that making a substantial impact for customers and businesses is crucial, even as tools and methodologies evolve.

author: TNN
description: A young Rohingya woman was trafficked from Bangladesh and confined in Hyderabad for five months. During her confinement, she was raped multiple times by four men, including one who falsely married her. The case came to light when the landlord forced entry to collect unpaid rent. After hearing about the abuse, the woman’s relatives contacted the police for help. Authorities arrested three suspects while the main accused remains at large.

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Aakash Chopra found himself the target of social media trolls after his prediction for India's chase in Wellington. With a witty tone, he clarified that he was referring to a 10-over target, which he deemed challenging. Notably, he remarked on the pitch's movement during New Zealand's innings, prompting his cautious stance.

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: The Kansas City Chiefs could consider reuniting with Tyreek Hill as they search for wide receiver help before the NFL trade deadline. Injuries to Rashee Rice and Tyquan Thornton have increased the team's urgency, but trade options remain limited. ESPN insider Adam Schefter confirmed Kansas City has contacted teams about receivers. Hill is nearing the final stages of rehabilitation from a serious knee injury, though his recovery and ability to regain peak form remain concerns.
title: Tyreek Hill to Chiefs? Trade rumors grow ahead of NFL deadline

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: In 2024, Travis Kelce partnered with breakfast brand Kodiak to donate 25,000 meals to children at Kansas City’s Operation Breakthrough. The contribution came as the nonprofit mourned co-founder Sister Berta, who established the organisation with Sister Corita in 1971. Serving more than 700 children daily, the centre continues their mission of supporting families. Kelce’s donation provided practical help while honouring Sister Berta’s lasting legacy of compassion and community service.
title: Travis Kelce helps provide 25,000 meals to children through charity effort

author: PEARL D'SOUZA
description: The special intensive revision of electoral rolls in Karnataka resulted in a reduction of 99.76 lakh electors. The final electoral rolls revealed a total of 4.55 crore eligible voters by October 27. Women made up a majority of the electorate, surpassing men by 3.7 lakh. Many electors were marked absent, shifted permanently, or marked as dead and duplicates. The Election Commission processed a net addition of 8.
title: Karnataka voter roll drops by nearly 1 crore, Gen Z makes up 20% of electorate

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: After the Houthis announced a missile strike, Brent crude prices jumped to $115 a barrel, intensifying fears of oil supply disruptions from the conflict-laden Middle East. Additionally, a slight uptick in US oil inventories influenced trader responses. With expectations that OPEC+ will stick to existing output targets in their next assembly, the landscape of the oil market remains increasingly intricate, especially with ongoing apprehensions regarding Russian crude exports.
title: Oil price today: Brent crude holds firm at $115 per barrel, WTI trades at $100

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Abhishek Sharma dazzled in the third T20I against New Zealand, smashing 85 sixes in 2026 and breaking Rohit Sharma's former record of 80 sixes from 2023. His scorching performance, scoring 113 runs off 38 balls, led India to a swift victory, as they chased down New Zealand's 199-run target in just 13.2 overs, securing a commanding 3-0 series advantage.
title: Abhishek Sharma scripts history, breaks Rohit Sharma's all-time world record

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In Massachusetts, a groundbreaking approach has emerged as two cranberry bogs have implemented solar panels above their crops. This eco-friendly strategy not only cuts farming expenses but also creates extra revenue through solar energy production. The initiative fosters healthier soil and revives forgotten bog areas, ensuring ongoing agricultural yield. Supported by state policies, this dual use of land is paving the way for agrivoltaics and sustainable farming practices.
title: Solar leases revive unprofitable Massachusetts cranberry bogs

author: DWAIPAYAN GHOSH
description: In Behala’s Sarsuna, three men faced public humiliation after they were accused of punishing a teenager. The youth was reportedly stripped and paraded at gunpoint for allegedly kissing a 13-year-old girl. Police conducted the parade as part of a crime scene recreation, drawing public attention and filming. Human rights groups criticized the police for resorting to such actions during the arrest.
title: After Kolkata naked mob justice, cops parade 3 semi-naked to ‘reconstruct crime’

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: The Michael J. Fox Foundation has evolved its Parkinson’s Progression Markers Initiative into the Parkinson’s Precision Medicine Initiative, focusing on tailored treatments based on individual biological differences in patients. With over 4,200 clinical participants and more than 47,000 online contributors, this initiative aims to innovate clinical trial designs and ensure treatments align with specific patient profiles, all while advancing research on Parkinson’s disease.
title: Michael J. Fox’s Parkinson’s study data downloaded over 50 million times

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: India achieved a remarkable six-wicket victory against New Zealand in the third T20I at Wellington's Hnry Stadium. Abhishek Sharma's impressive 113 runs and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's 45 runs set a strong foundation for the win. The opening duo scored a record 118 runs in the first six overs to dismantle New Zealand's bowling attack. India's bowlers effectively executed yorkers to limit New Zealand to 198 runs after 20 overs.
title: 'Ball was still seaming': Iyer 'mind-boggled' by Abhishek, Sooryavanshi's blitz

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In an intriguing legal twist, a Michigan appeals court has vacated a $1.55 million judgment against a couple who pulled out of purchasing a home over unresolved ownership concerns. The court uncovered notable procedural errors in the trial, chiefly concerning jury instructions and discussions deemed confidential. Consequently, the previous damages assessment was overturned, and the case is now set to return to the trial court.
title: Appeals court overturns $1.55M judgment in $1.275M Michigan home sale

author: ARVIND CHAUHAN
description: A prominent Indian singer obtained US citizenship in 2022 but failed to report his stays in India. During a recent visit to Agra, hotel staff alerted officials about his lack of identification. The singer submitted necessary documents only after being prompted by the authorities. His misuse of Aadhaar allowed him to avoid tourist fees typically charged to foreign nationals.
title: Star Indian vocal singer with US passport visiting India since 2022 without filing Form C

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a significant legal victory, an Australian homeowner triumphed over his neighbor who contributed to ongoing flooding that devastated his land and pool. The New South Wales Court of Appeal upheld the initial ruling, assigning liability to the uphill property owners for inadequate drainage. They were ordered to compensate A$99,382.01 and to execute necessary repairs to avert further flooding.
title: Australian court upholds A$99,382 damages for neighbour's flooded backyard

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In County Cork, Sean Keating, a dedicated dairy farmer, has innovatively transformed a portion of his land into a solar farm. This eco-friendly venture enables him to harvest renewable energy while still allowing sheep to graze comfortably beneath the solar installations. Expected to power about 150 households annually, this project showcases the critical support from the government and could potentially motivate other farmers to explore similar sustainable energy alternatives.
title: Irish farmer installs 1,008 solar panels on 1.5 acres while sheep graze below
